heading: Why Businesses Choose Expendesk
subheading: From spreadsheet chaos to complete financial control — compare the old way with Expendesk, line by line.

comparisons.detail: Every expense flows through smart, rule-based automation — zero spreadsheet wrangling.
Claims reach the right approver in seconds, not days.
Snap, upload, and never lose a single receipt again.
See exactly where every rupee flows, the moment it moves.
Out-of-policy spend is flagged before it ever hits payout.
Employees get paid faster with zero manual follow-ups.

cta.heading: Stop Managing Expenses. Start Controlling Them.
cta.body: Your business deserves more than spreadsheets, emails, and reimbursement chaos. Expendesk gives growing businesses the visibility, automation, and control needed to scale confidently.
cta.prompt: Ready to see Expendesk in action?
cta.note: Just a smarter way to manage business expenses.
